say:2:1810609001:0.text: Insolent fool! You dare block my path?
say:2:1810609001:0.source_cn: 不知好歹的家伙，你竟然敢拦我？

say:3:1810609002:1.text: My apologies, Sir Rogan. By order of Her Ladyship, any Graveborn lacking proper etiquette are forbidden from attending the ball.
say:3:1810609002:1.source_cn: 非常抱歉，罗杰先生。领主阁下有令，禁止不懂贵族礼仪的亡...

say:4:1810609003:1.text: What does that have to do with me? I've lived in Novaris for nearly eight hundred years. I am a noble! How could I not know etiquette?!
say:4:1810609003:1.source_cn: 那和我有关什么关系？我在诺珐斯生活了快八百年，早就是贵...

say:5:1810609004:1.text: ... At the last ball, my lord, the matter of your harassment of Lady Shamonda has not slipped the Lady's mind.
say:5:1810609004:1.source_cn: ……上次舞会，您调戏莎梦娜小姐的事，领主阁下还没忘呢。

say:6:1810609005:1.text: Her orders were clear. <style="highlight">Unless you master proper etiquette, you are not permitted entry</style>.
say:6:1810609005:1.source_cn: 这次领主阁下特意嘱咐，<style=highlight...

say:7:1810609006:1.text: Until Lady Shamonda forgives you, Her Ladyship will not hear your side. Please leave.
say:7:1810609006:1.source_cn: 莎梦娜小姐原谅您之前，领主阁下不会听您解释的。请离开吧。
